d:
Are you ready for the Swimming World Cup 2026?
The World Cup takes on a new adventure and heads out on the Silk Road Tour:
Baku (Oct 1–3)
Tashkent (Oct 8–10)
Astana (Oct 15–17)
John Mason and James Gibson are ready to take you through the locations, the new Wild Card Selection for the World Aquatics Swimming Championships (25m), the rules and strategy, and of course, the big names joining the Silk Road Tour!
